## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Codex 最新桌面客户端把页面语言提供器移到懒加载模块后，API 桌面实例显示“页面语言：客户端结构已变化，等待适配”的问题。管理器沿页面入口检查可达的 JavaScript 模块图，并验证语言提供器仍由运行时导入和调用；不依赖固定的资源文件名或客户端版本号。
- 当页面语言与普通 / Fast、Ultra 位于不同资源时，管理器分别验证和改写每个资源。页面语言状态会等待它需要的资源都成功加载；资源变化或验证失败时保持官方原始页面并报告适配未加载。
- 保留实例中的手动语言选择；未指定语言时继续跟随 Codex 的系统语言。资源图检查具有深度、数量及字节上限，结构歧义时会安全退回原始页面。

- Fixes the “Page language: client structure changed; awaiting adaptation” state in Codex API desktop instances after recent clients moved their locale provider into a lazy-loaded module. The manager inspects modules reachable from the page entry and verifies that the runtime imports and calls the locale provider, without relying on fixed asset names or client version numbers.
- When page language and Normal / Fast or Ultra live in separate resources, each resource is verified and patched independently. The page-language status waits for all resources it needs; changed or unverifiable resources retain the official page and report the adaptation as unavailable.
- Preserves a language explicitly selected in the instance; when none is selected, the client continues to follow the system language. Module-graph inspection has depth, count and byte limits and fails closed to the original page when the structure is ambiguous.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 支持范围 / Supported scope

此兼容增强用于受管 Codex API 桌面实例；Codex CLI、官方 OAuth 原生桌面实例与其他客户端不注入页面语言补丁。适配能力由已安装客户端实际资源结构检测；不能仅凭此版本说明推断所有未来客户端均兼容。此版本不改变图片 API 路由或默认模型；原生图片接口已在 v0.12.0 发布。

The compatibility enhancement applies to manager-owned Codex API desktop instances. Codex CLI, native OAuth desktop instances and other clients do not receive the page-language patch. Support is detected from the installed client resources; this release does not guarantee compatibility with every future client build. This release does not change image API routing or its default model; native image endpoints were released in v0.12.0.

## 验证来源 / Verification

真实安装的 ChatGPT / Codex Desktop `26.1021.31345` 已通过资源能力检测：页面语言、普通 / Fast 与 Ultra 均可用；生成的隔离清单包含主界面资源和语言提供器资源。没有登录真实账号或发送上游模型请求。

全量 TypeScript 回归、类型检查、生产构建及打包应用验收结果将在发布流程完成后填写，并链接对应来源提交、GitHub Actions 与 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。图片 API 真实供应商请求不属于本次变更验证。

The installed ChatGPT / Codex Desktop `26.1021.31345` passed resource capability detection for page language, Normal / Fast and Ultra. Its isolated resource manifest contains the main renderer resource and locale-provider resource. No real account was signed in and no upstream model request was sent.

The final full TypeScript regression, typecheck, production build and packaged-app results will be recorded after release verification, with links to the source commit, GitHub Actions run and `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Live provider image requests are outside this change's verification scope.
